newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN KB-SECURITIES PULLS OUT OF ACTIVCARD IPO.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN KB-SECURITIES PULLS OUT OF ACTIVCARD IPO.

text.p: Belgian broker KB-Securities said on Monday it had pulled out of being a co-manager in the initial public offering of French smart card maker ActivCard SA on Europe's new growth stocks market Easdaq.
"We are no longer a co-manager," a Kredietbank official said, declining to be identified or give reasons for the decision.
Lead manager of the IPO is French broker Hambrecht & Quist Saint Dominique, which said earlier on Monday the final issue price of the offer had been set at $8 a share.
Another firm named in ActivCard's preliminary prospectus as co-manager, Britain's Beeson Gregory, was not immediately able to confirm whether they were still taking part.
On Saturday, ActivCard announced that the indicative price for the IPO had been lowered to $8-$10 from $10-$12 originally and that the offer would be extended until December 16.

A spokeswoman at the French broker told Reuters on Monday it had been decided the shares would be offered at the discounted final issue price of $8 in view of the poor climate in equity markets generally over the past few days. The shares are due to begin trading on Easdaq on December 20.
